question: Biodrop SAC avocado oil company parent owner
markdown:
Biodrop S.A.C.
is a closed joint-stock company (Sociedad Anónima Cerrada) registered in Peru with RUC 20612198471, specializing in the processing and export of fruit and vegetable oils (such as raw avocado oil). Public trade registries and corporate databases list it as an independent private entity rather than a subsidiary of a larger multinational parent corporation.
